messages:
maya: Pushed a draft of the v1.7.0 release notes. Main highlights: Adaptive routing GA, embedding streaming opt-in, and updated Python/TS SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1299
santosh: scanning the hero + TL;DR. Looks good. Noticed some anchor jumps on the changelog page though when clicking from the index.
priya: same, clicking "Adaptive routing" from /changelog/index.html lands at top of page, not the section. Repro on staging and local dev server.
lucas: could be a different slug generator between old mkdocs-slugger and the new markdown-it anchor plugin. They change unicode normalization.
maya: cc @anita can you add a known-issue bullet in the draft release? Keep it small: anchor mismatch on staging.
anita: added bullet under "Known issues": "Changelog index anchors may jump to page top on staging due to heading ID changes in the markdown processor. Workaround: use browser find (Ctrl+F) or direct permalink. Fix rolling out."
santosh: also: python SDK example in the draft still shows client.create_embedding(model='old', ...) — our SDK now requires model_id param. I can patch.
priya: thanks, please also update TS snippet; it still uses the old response shape. I'll open a tiny PR to update both examples and mark the diffs in the release notes under "Developer notes".
lucas: for anchor fix I can add a build-time slug normalization step. Proposed function (node):
```js
// docs/scripts/slugify.js
const {normalize} = require('unorm');
module.exports = function slug(s){
  return normalize(s, 'NFKD')
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-');
};
```

lucas: will add redirects for the old anchors too so external links won't break.
santosh: docs-bot linkcheck results (after PR preview):
docs-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-1299--docs.redwood.com — status: linkcheck FAILED (2 broken anchors)
priya: linkcheck output:
```
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing-ga
ERROR: /sdk/ts/examples.html: missing anchor #sdk-examples
```

lucas: I'm opening PR 1300 to add slugify + redirect table. Will include a small migration note in the changelog: "Heading ID generation changed; we added redirects."
maya: PR 1299 updated with SDK snippet fixes and a short "Developer notes" section that lists code changes and migration tips.
anita: can we add an ETA on the known-issue? If slugify + redirects land, should be resolved in the next deploy (~30-90 mins).
santosh: added ETA line to the known-issue note and flagged the release draft as "pre-release" for legal review.
docs-bot: PR 1299 merged by maya into main. PR 1300 (slugify + redirects) opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1300
priya: quick QA: adaptive anchor working on preview after redirect patch; SDK example updated in docs site. One remaining issue: embedding streaming anchor still 404 on older cached previews.
lucas: will add redirect for embedding streaming to PR1300 too.
maya: great work — i'll finish copy, squash a tiny changelog bullet about the anchor migration, and publish v1.7.0 once PR1300 merges. Closing thread unless new linkcheck failures appear. :v:
